pages.text: Tausi Bond Fund factsheet, issued by Nyota Asset Managers (SYN). Tausi Bond Fund is a bond fund and its objective is to generate regular income from government and corporate bonds. The management fee of Tausi Bond Fund is 1.9 percent per annum. The minimum initial investment in Tausi Bond Fund is SYN Sh 1,000, and the minimum top-up is SYN Sh 100. Over the 12 months to 2026-09-30 Tausi Bond Fund delivered an effective annual yield of 14.0 percent.

Withdrawals from Tausi Bond Fund are paid within 1 business days. The main holdings of Tausi Bond Fund are corporate bonds (55 percent), Treasury bonds (15 percent) and bond-like fixed deposits (10 percent). Pwani Trustees (SYN) acts as trustee of Tausi Bond Fund and holds its assets separately from the manager. Tausi Bond Fund was launched in 2014 and is licensed by the SYN Capital Markets Authority. Past performance is not a guarantee of future results and the value of units can fall. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
